name: Li Yen-nien
bio: Li Yen-nien (Li Yannian, 李延年) was a court musician of the Western Han dynasty, master of music to Emperor Wu. Born into a family of entertainers, he was known as a singer and dancer who composed new melodies for the emperor's court. His year of birth is not recorded; the date used here is approximate.

He is remembered chiefly for a short song about a beauty from the north, which he is said to have sung before the emperor and which led to his sister becoming a favourite of the court. The song is preserved in the early anthology Yutai xinyong and in Han historical writing, and he is said to have died around 90 BC.

poems.title: 北方有佳人 (Bei fang you jia ren)
poems.author: Li Yen-nien
poems.text:
北方有佳人，絕世而獨立。
一顧傾人城，再顧傾人國。
寧不知傾城復傾國，佳人難再得。
